text:
Rita Park: Hey folks! Rita here — joined Eng Platform today. Hybrid from NYC (EST). I have a corgi named Mochi, an embarrassing sneaker collection, and an aggressive houseplant (peperomia). Also big fan of tacos 🌮. Quick Q: where do I pick up my badge and is there a window desk available? :wave:

Ben (People Ops): Welcome Rita!! :tada: Badge kiosk is in the 2nd floor lobby, buzzer 'PeopleOps'. I'll meet you there at 9:15 if that works.

Noor: hi rita!! Mochi pics pls :dog: Also we usually do a casual team lunch on Tuesdays — vegetarian options available.

Talia: welcome!! sneakers + plants = instant friend status. 😎 We have a desk-plant swap on Friday if you want to join.

Aria: welcome Rita — ping @Ben or drop into #eng-platform to grab a quick tour. Also FYI we have a 'corgi appreciation' thread that people post to.

Rita Park: Thanks all!! @Ben 9:15 works. I'll bring Mochi pics tomorrow — can't promise they're professional. :sweat_smile: Veg tacos sound amazing @Noor.

Mikaela: coffee or tea preference? I do mug assignments for new folks (very official).

Rita Park: Green tea please. And if it helps, I prefer a window desk but I'm flexible.

Sam: @Facilities could we try to prioritize a window desk for Rita? Also FYI parking for new staff is on B2 — bring ID.

Facilities: Hi Rita — welcome! We'll DM about desk options and confirm badge escort. If you have any accessibility needs, let us know and we'll sort it before you arrive.

Leif: Welcome aboard! If you like sneakers there's a small community that does a monthly swap. I'll add you to that thread.

Rita Park: Amazing — thanks everyone, feeling very welcome already :heart: See you at the kiosk!
